reviews.review: The game is not bad at all. I don't know why it had such a negative start. It's fun regardless of the mixed reviews.

Mass Effect Andromeda... If you look at the game from the outside, without playing it - you can see a lot of content, super graphics, open worlds and much improved combat system compared to the last game in the series. Yes, there are joints with facial animation and character movement in сutscenes that do not allow you to take this world seriously =) But if you play it yourself... There is a constant feeling that something is tightened and you can not understand what. As if forcing yourself to play...
Storyline quests normal, but the rest of the quests or do not fully disclose their history or emphasize that you play in the adventure for children (just such an attitude of heroes to the world and situations). For example, the quest of our companion: he just gave zhizniznenno-necessary routes and secrets to the enemies that- to make friends with them, and they - threw him.... So we have to sort it all out. And during the mission we see by dialogs that no one cares about this situation and it even amuses them.... After the mission, we just say, “You can't do that.” That's all the punishment for the person who leaked important information to the enemies. And that's the kind of trash that's almost everywhere. Seriosnosti this galactic epic does not even smell (although the main plot seems to be normal). It took me 158 hours to get all the achieves and close all the content. And it's not much, if you compare with other action rpgs, but the feeling of having played 300 hours.... I even took a break for a month, during the passage (this is such a fascinating game). If the developers will make a sequel, it should be more “severe” than this “kindergarten”. Do I recommend it for purchase? - Yes, only at a discount.

This is a solid game.  It would do better if it didn't carry the "Mass Effect" label.  There's enough carryover to make it enjoyable, but not enough to put in the pantheon of other Mass Effect titles.

Story feels generic, combat feels boring, an okay game, but not particularly fun, seems very standard and a little dated.

I prefer the other mass effect games a lot more, the story makes them worth it, which this games just doesn't have, I'd rather have the disk space than slog through this game
